notes.title: The Fish Stick Protocol Demo is LIVE!
notes.content:
[p]Hi Workers, [/p][p][/p][p]Starting today, you and your friends can officially get tossed into strange, hostile dimensions and start decorating your boss's manor like the true, slightly reckless interior designers you were always meant to be. The chaos begins now.[/p][p][/p][p]Download the demo here:
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3701430/Fish_Stick_Protocol_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][hr][/hr][h3]What’s in the demo[/h3][p][b]Dimensions[/b][/p][list][*][p]Explore dimensions up to hostility 3[/p][/*][*][p]A few exotic ones might appear if luck is on your side[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Shop[/b][/p][list][*][p]Two trusty consumable tools plus the mighty party popper[/p][/*][*][p]The more advanced gadgets will have to wait for the full game[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Hub equipment[/b][/p][list][*][p]Some upgrades for the hub are available[/p][/*][*][p]Unlockables in the demo: selling machine, some storage shelves, paint showers[/p][/*][*][p]Not in demo: elevator, cleaning machine, most shelves, soundboard[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Manor[/b][/p][list][*][p]The entrance and lobby are available at the start[/p][/*][*][p]The main hall can be unlocked[/p][/*][*][p]The rest of the manor remains locked in the demo[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Cosmetics[/b][/p][list][*][p]A short selection of hats, charms, and backpacks is ready[/p][/*][*][p]Most of the cosmetic items are locked for now[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Indie Fan Fest[/h3][p]We are also part of the very first Indie Fan Fest organized by The Mix and Digital Bandidos. For the event I put together a brand new gameplay video with my commentary on top.[/p][p]You can watch the event live on Twitch on September 24 at 9 AM PDT / 6 PM CEST
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.twitch.tv/indiefanfest"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you for checking out the demo. I cannot wait to see the messes you create, the artifacts you grab, and the very creative ways you will probably get yourselves killed. If you enjoy the demo and feel like sharing your thoughts, [b]leaving a review on Steam helps us a ton[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]- VirginRedemption (I am the purple one in the gif)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477328/77595da6cee93c180f6649d986427c8bca70843f.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The Open Beta ends today
notes.content:
[p]Hello Workers,[/p][p]Thank you so much for playing [i]Fish Stick Protocol[/i], sharing your feedback, and reporting issues. Over [b]7,326 workers[/b] joined the open beta, which is an incredible number for a small indie game that came out of nowhere. We truly cannot thank you enough for your support.[/p][p]If you would like to help us even more in shaping the game for release, please consider [b]adding it to your wishlist[/b]. It really makes a big difference for indie teams like ours.[/p][p]You are also welcome to [url="https://discord.gg/qq6wnVMZTX" buttoncolor="#ffae00"]join our Discord[/url] to chat with the devs, catch the latest news, get sneak peeks, and sometimes even play the game with us.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477328/aee330edadbbf2e61dfff2ac5f3f918c3f317b68.png"][/img][/p][p]See you at the coffee machine ☕[/p][p]Cheers,
VirginRedemption and the entire Maracas Team[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Fish Stick Protocol – Open Beta
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477328/43dc1b0bdb71ec71af1f42b4ff8c669770290d7b.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey everyone! Here's what’s coming this summer for Fish Stick Protocol and how you can be part of it:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Open Beta on Steam – August 14 to 25[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Everyone will be able to join the [b]Open Beta directly on Steam[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Make sure to:[/p][list][*][p][b]Request access[/b] on the Steam page under "Join the Fish Stick Protocol Playtest",[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wishlist the game[/b] if you haven’t already, it really helps us,[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]During the Open Beta:[/p][list][*][p]Feel free to [b]share content[/b] (screenshots, streams, videos – all welcome),[/p][/*][*][p]Drop your [b]feedback, suggestions, and bug reports[/b] here on [url="https://discord.com/invite/qq6wnVMZTX" style="button"]Discord [/url]or in the [b]Steam[/b] Community Hub,[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Reminder[/b]: This is still an in-development version of the game, so bugs and missing content are expected. Your help is crucial in shaping Fish Stick Protocol into something great[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for being part of the journey!

[/p]

notes.title: Gameplay Trailer Reveal
notes.content:
Hello little Fish Sticks, 

We're happy to announce that we'll reveal the [b]new gameplay trailer[/b] of [b]Fish Stick Protocol[/b] during the [b]AG French Direct on May 28[/b]. 

We hope to see a lot of you on the chat asking your [b]questions about the project[/b]. 

Don't forget to [b]wishlist [/b]the game and join our [b]Discord [/b]to have news about the coming [b]BETA[/b]. 

Thank you,
VirginRedemption

notes.title: Join the Fish Stick Protocol Playtest on Discord
notes.content:
We’re looking for frosted [b]playtesters [/b] to explore the chaotic dimensions and give us [b]feedback[/b] while collecting artifacts for the Owner's collection. Your input will help us refine the experience of FSP. The playtest will take place on our [b]Discord server[/b], so join us here:

👉 [url=https://discord.gg/GqkC7TDeAn]Join the Playtest on Discord[/url]

Even if you're not interested in the playtest, feel free to join the Discord anyway. We need new workers to clean the showers... People are leaving a lot of bad thoughts in there.

See you on the other side of the portal. If you make it back...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477328/d730933bb7d919e1eb5f95b2c934126d77a3de77.gif[/img]
